# proxmox_sdn_zones (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN zones from `/cluster/sdn/zones`, sorted by `zone`. `state` and `pending` show what is still uncommitted, so a forgotten `proxmox_sdn_apply` stays visible.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# `state` and `pending` reveal configuration that is staged but not committed.
data "proxmox_sdn_zones" "vlan" {
  type = "vlan"
}

output "pending_zones" {
  value = { for zone in data.proxmox_sdn_zones.vlan.zones : zone.zone => zone.state }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to one zone type. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Matching zones, sorted by `zone`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `bridge` (String) Bridge of a `vlan`/`qinq` zone.
- `ipam` (String) IPAM id, when set.
- `mtu` (Number) Zone MTU, when set.
- `nodes` (List of String) Nodes the zone is created on.
- `pending` (Map of String) Staged properties with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Staging state: `new` or `changed`.
- `type` (String) Zone type.
- `zone` (String) Zone identifier.
